caption: Comparison of enriched gene sets across groups. Selection: in each group, up to 4 gene sets with the smallest adjusted P among those with adjusted P < 0.05 (ties broken by larger gene ratio, then term ID); the union of 8 sets is shown; rows grouped by the first group (in axis order) in which the set has adjusted P < 0.05, then ordered by its smallest adjusted P across groups (ties by term ID). Gene ratio = input genes in the set / input genes annotated in the database. Dot colour, -log10 adjusted P; dot size, gene ratio. An empty position means the set is not significant in that group.

definition.gene_ratio: gene ratio = input genes in the set / input genes annotated in the database
definition.ordering: rows grouped by the first group (in axis order) in which the set has adjusted P < 0.05, then ordered by its smallest adjusted P across groups (ties by term ID)
definition.selection: in each group, up to 4 gene sets with the smallest adjusted P among those with adjusted P < 0.05 (ties broken by larger gene ratio, then term ID); the union of 8 sets is shown
